description: Peak load of electricity demand forecast using machine learning and electricity generation planning is a data set deposited in NRCT Data Center by its authors May Thazin Phuu Wai. Short-term load forecasting informs power system planning, operational scheduling, and economic dispatch. However, forecasting accuracy often deteriorates under irregular calendar conditions, such as weekends, public holidays, and bridging holidays, when load behavior deviates from typical daily patterns. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
